class.name: ResourceServer
class.brief_description: Singleton for managing resource domains and visual editors.
class.description: [ResourceServer] is the central orchestration system for the Zyris Resource ecosystem. It allows modules to register "Domains", which associate specific [Resource] types with specialized visual editors and creation rules. Core Zyris domains are registered automatically, including: - [b]Ability System[/b]: GameplayAbility, GameplayEffect, AttributeSet. - [b]AI[/b]: BehaviorTree. - [b]Gaia[/b]: BiomeDef, WeatherDef. - [b]Inventory[/b]: Item, Inventory. - [b]Quests[/b]: QuestGraph.

method.name: get_domain_for_resource
method.description: Returns the registered domain name for a given resource class type.

method.name: get_domain_info
method.description: Returns information about a registered domain.

method.name: get_registered_domains
method.description: Returns a list of all currently registered resource domains.

method.name: register_domain
method.description: Registers a new resource domain with the server.
